entries.name: Price Chatham

expected.charges: Breach of the peace — Freedom Ride arrival at the Jackson Trailways terminal, June 2, 1961.
expected.convicted: Yes — the Jackson Freedom Rides breach-of-peace prosecution
expected.sentence: Jailed and sent to Parchman, where he conducted a hunger strike of approximately twenty-four days against the segregation of riders within the prison. A contemporary report indicates release around July 11, 1961 — entered as probable, not fully verified; the prison discharge register is still needed for absolute confirmation.

updates.sentence: Jailed following his June 2, 1961 arrest and subsequently confined at Parchman. He conducted a hunger strike against segregation in custody. Released in July 1961; the previously recorded July 11 day remains unverified.

entries.rationale: CORE-Lator June1961 p1 explicitly identifies Chatham among riders who remained jailed and fasted since June2 arrest. July31 Guardian describes his completed term and forthcoming demonstration. Existing release description calls July11 probable rather than verified: retain July at month precision, no spurious39-day counter.
